plain_english_definition: Of opportunities that closed this quarter how many we won
numerator_definition: count of opportunities with stage Closed Won and close date in period
denominator_definition: count of opportunities with stage Closed Won or Closed Lost and close date in period
key_assumptions: no-decision deals are bucketed as Lost
known_limitations: biased by which deals happened to close in the period

plain_english_definition: Of opportunities created in the quarter how many we have won
numerator_definition: count of cohort opportunities now Closed Won
denominator_definition: count of opportunities created in cohort
key_assumptions: cohorts younger than one median cycle are incomplete
known_limitations: a lower bound until the cohort closes out

plain_english_definition: Revenue retained and expanded from customers we had a year ago
formula: (Start ARR - churn - downgrade + expansion) / Start ARR
numerator_definition: starting ARR less churn and downgrades plus expansion
denominator_definition: ARR of customers active at period start
known_limitations: differs from chained monthly NRR when growth is non-linear

plain_english_definition: Months of gross profit needed to repay acquisition cost
numerator_definition: fully loaded S&M cost in period
denominator_definition: new customers acquired in period times new MRR times gross margin
known_limitations: steady-state assumption fails when spend changes sharply
